simple.summary: פּוּג (pûwg) means to be sluggish First listed occurrence: Gen 45 26.

definitions.usage: cease, be feeble, faint, be slacked.
definitions.full: H6313. pug [ מּוּג ] verb grow numb (Arabic grow cool ; **Syriac become cold ( Matt 24:12 ), fail, become weak, inefficient ; מּוּג ᵑ7 become cold, fail, be or (Pa`el) make ineffectual ; Late Hebrew id., fail, vanish . Syriac be cold ; מּוּג ᵑ7 cease, be helpless ; Late Hebrew id. vanish ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular לִבּוֺ וַיָּפָג Gen 45:26 ; 3 feminine singular תָּפוּג Psa 77:3 of hand (si vera lectio, see נגר ), i.e. drop helpless; Hab 1:4 of תּוֺרָה , i.e. be ineffective. Niph`al Perfect 1singular וְנִדְכֵּיתִי נְפוּגֹתִי Psa 38:9 I am benumbed and crushed (figurative); read probably also אֶמּוֺגָה 88:16 (for ᵑ0 ἅπ . λεγ . אָפוּנָה ), Ol Hup Dy Gr Che אָפוּגָה .
